CT scanning of the neck with contrast enhancement is useful in the management of patients with suspected peritonsillitis.
CT with contrast enabled the differentiation of PTA (peritonsillar Abscess) from peritonsilLar cellulitis in 100% of patients and demonstrated abscess in 85%.
CT with contrast is useful in differentiating PTA from peritonitis, and that it can help to avoid unnecessary drainage procedures and reduce morbidity in patients with peritonal abscess.

computed tomography is an effective and accurate method for diagnosis of peritonsilar abscess.
